node.title: DLI primitive-ledger zone coverage: W_cl is at most 1/32 at every official production level
node.statement: At every official production row R, after generated-field normalization and first-owner de-duplication of multiplier shadows and level lifts, every level L=1,...,34 satisfies W_cl(R,L)<=1/32. Here W_cl is exactly the C1' primitive signed-shift orbit ledger sum 2N_L 2^(-w(O)) over primitive orbits with L+1<=w(O)<=L+5, and N_L=256L. A certificate must pin the row and generated field, prove the primitive ledger complete in that weight window, and prove ownership. Density bounds over primes and lists of merely exhibited relations are not coverage. No C1', C2'', residual near-peak bound, final endpoint, or reserve credit is part of this statement. || F-ROUND 1 SURVIVED (2026-07-13, pre-registered; packet at background/nodes/dli_wcl_zone_coverage/notes/wz_fround1_20260713/, 11 Modal apps, exact-rational verdict path; catches #190-#197 = wz-C1..C8): kill lines 1a (forced-structure saturation), 1b (recurring orbit family), 2 (scaling anomaly) did NOT trip across q <= 2^27, n' in {64,128}, L in {1,2}; 12/12 banked M2 cells reproduced EXACTLY on two engines; mutation + lift + shadow controls all trip. STRUCTURAL FINDING (#190/wz-C1): at official aspect N_L = 256L the minimum orbit mass is 16L/2^L > 1/32 iff L <= 12, so WCL-ZONE at L <= 12 is EQUIVALENT to ledger EMPTINESS in the window — the 1/32 threshold prices mass only at L >= 13. HONEST NEAR-MISS (#193/wz-C4, round-2 primary target): family B (L=2) shows monotone density ratio rho 1.62 -> 2.40 -> 4.65 across three scales (below the pre-registered 3-witness/4x compound kill but the only sustained trend observed). KNOWN GAPS: the pose's shadow/lift first-owner dedup has NO reference implementation and materially changes W_cl (observed 4 -> 1) — a canonical spec is owed before certificate work (#191/wz-C2); 2-power n' analogues cannot see the odd-n' forced-family channel — round 2 must add n' = 96/192 cells (#192/wz-C3), though pure odd subgroup-sum relations are PROVABLY excluded at every official level (d | 512L odd forces d | L vs survival forcing d > 2L-1). Evidence weight: analogue scales only; the official-row density-vs-row gap (the node's core difficulty) is untouched. || F-ROUND 2 SURVIVED (2026-07-13, pre-registered; packet at notes/wz2_fround2_20260713/, 14 Modal apps; catches #198-#204 = wz2-C1..C7): PART 1 — the round-1 family-B trend RESOLVED BENIGN (rho 1.615, 2.395, 4.648 then TURNOVER 3.62, 0.00 at the pre-registered extension scales; Poisson-consistent; escalate branch not triggered). PART 2 — odd-n' mixed channel clean: forced ledger = {orbit(Phi_n')} exactly at all 108 L=1 cells, absent at L >= 2 (2-3-norm exclusion, zero exceptions); PROVED LEMMA banked: no fixed integer vector is forced at any official level (upgrades round-1's pure-subgroup exclusion to the whole fixed-vector channel — official mixed-channel risk is q-dependent constructions only). PART 0 — the #191 dedup canonical spec DISCHARGED (implementation-grade, grounded in the banked M2 machinery; 12/12 conformance + mutation controls; round-1 and M2 values reproduced exactly) with EIGHT ratification points RATIFY-1..8 owed to the maintainer (two load-bearing: RATIFY-4 singular-source witness scope, RATIFY-6 lift admissibility gate). F-round state 2/2. MAJOR INTERFACE FINDING #198 (wz2-C1, blocks the downstream assembly AS WRITTEN): with the pose's own deduplicated ledger, C1' FAILS at the banked accident row (L=1, q=7937): W_cl 236 -> 8 canonical orbits (the lift owns 3 via the previously unpriced admissible N=16 companion; 1240 shadow links), K'_dedup = 6.5019 > 4 — the M3 CORRECTED POSE uses ONE symbol W_cl in both the <= 1/32 zone bound and the C1' allowance, and they cannot be the same ledger. Maintainer resolution owed before any certificate work (MAINTAINER_DECISIONS decision 4). || SCHEDULE CORRECTION r2 + RAW-LEDGER RULING (2026-07-13, wave-7 audited, w7-C1/w7-C2 = catches #205/#206, MAINTAINER-RATIFIED 2026-07-13 in-session): the production schedule of record is the dyadic odd-index tower t=2^33, j=0..33, ell_j=ceil(floor(t/2^j)/2), N_j=256*ell_j, n'_j=2N_j, dims (2^32,...,2,1,1) summing to t (skew-tower packet points 2/4; S6; C2PP Sigma_j L_j = t) -- NOT N_L=256L at L=1..34, which conflated level index with level dimension; and W_cl is the RAW primitive signed-shift ledger (no shadow/lift/cluster de-duplication; every primitive orbit at its own level and weight, per the C1' pose of record and dli_wcl_raw_ledger_interface_guardrail). Instantiation of #190: the emptiness-equivalent levels are exactly the five terminal slots ell in {1,1,2,4,8}; first counting dimension ell=16 (min mass 1/256). All official rings are 2-power, so the wz2 dedup spec's singular-source path (RATIFY-4) cannot fire on official rows -- analogue-census-only. STATE AFTER THE WAVE-7 EXCLUSIONS: the Newton cutoff (w<=2ell) closes every window at ell>=8 outright (30 levels, W_cl=0) and w=2 at ell=1, w=3,4 at ell=2, w=5..8 at ell=4; the ambient censuses close w=3,4 at ell=1 for every q<2^256 with v_2(q-1)>=41. WCL-ZONE is now EQUIVALENT to six emptiness slots: (1,5),(1,6),(2,5),(2,6),(2,7),(4,9). || AMBER (2026-07-19, maintainer-directed ceremony): CONDITIONAL on exactly the four slot reds (req, gate=all) — the ratified equivalence WCL-ZONE <=> {(1,5),(1,6),(2,7),(4,9)} emptiness (schedule r2 + raw ledger + the audited Newton/census/exclusion ladder, all PROVED). F-round record (2/2) stands; conditional.md is the assembly of record. || EXTENDED WINDOW (C1'-r3 adoption, 2026-07-19): the ledger window widens L+1..L+5 -> L+1..L+7 (W_ext; the aggregate assembly arithmetic is UNCHANGED: E_j <= 41/8, 41^34 < 2^202). At ell >= 8 the two added weight classes are FREE (Newton short-window, L+7 <= 2L for L >= 7); at ell in {1,1,2,4} per-orbit masses exceed 1/32 throughout, so the bound REMAINS equivalent to slot emptiness — the leaf set widens by SIX to TEN slots: (1,5),(1,6),(1,7),(1,8),(2,7),(2,8),(2,9),(4,9),(4,10),(4,11). || WINDOW/RESIDUAL OF RECORD (2026-07-22 forced correction): the ledger window is L+1..L+7 (L = dimension ell, schedule r2); the raw ledger rules (decision 4a — the leading de-duplication phrase is historical display); the zero-event residual is EXACTLY the ten req-wired slot cells, machine-certified complete by verify_slot_decomposition.py.
